1531-4279-6255--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1531-4279-6255--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

5107-5261-7014.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
5107-5261-7014.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

2023-4770-6006-6965.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

512-1432-7308.easyPrerequisites:
Mona Lisa and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
Mona Lisa has power 2 or greater.
512-1432-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1432-7308.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Mona Lisa's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-4029-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Benevolent Hydra
Repeat.

215-850-4359.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-4359.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

147-5686-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5686-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5686-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-3480-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1322-2203-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1322-2203-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-3490-4659-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4659-6752.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1879-2478.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2608-3784-4499.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

5220-6425-6900.manaNeeded: {2}{W} in nonblue mana if Azorius Herald is in your hand
5220-6425-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4 if Azorius Herald is on top of your library.
5220-6425-6900.description:
Cast Azorius Herald either from your hand by paying {2}{W} in nonblue mana, or from the top of your library by paying 3 life.
When Azorius Herald enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, causing you to gain 4 life and then sacrifice Azorius Herald.
When Azorius Herald dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Azorius Herald from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

560-2457-4772-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Soldier and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

4336-5220-5683-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Kobolds of Kher Keep and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

222-2060-5231-6701.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
Szarel has power 3 or greater or you have another creature card in your graveyard.
222-2060-5231-6701.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, and the other creature returned in step 1, if applicable, adding {R} for each creature sacrificed.
When Slimefoot and Squee and up to one other creature are sacrificed, Szarel triggers that many times, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler for each trigger.
Activate Crystalline Crawler up to three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding up to {1}{B}{G}.
Repeat.
222-2060-5231-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

804-2781.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Sakashima the Impostor.
804-2781.description:
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have Sakashima the Impostor enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-3129-4289-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-3129-4289-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-3129-4289-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1817-4779-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
1817-4779-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of the Lonis spell.
Resolve both Lonis spells.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 4.
1817-4779-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

2061-2556-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons each turn.
2061-2556-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1322-1328-2105.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1322-1328-2105.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1283-1765-2034-4124.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {1}, attaching it to Chishiro.
When Whip Silk enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {2}.
Activate Whip Silk's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-1491-2872-4417.notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling attached to Clever Conjurer.
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
1283-1491-2872-4417.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Clever Conjurer by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {2}, removing the -1/-1 counter from Clever Conjurer and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's first ability to draw infinite cards.

179-1371-4624.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is equal to or greater than 2^X, where X is the number of opponents you have.
179-1371-4624.description:
Cast Revenge by paying {4}{W}{B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Revenge.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Revenge, causing the opponent to lose life equal to their life total, and causing a different player to lose half their life total, rounded up.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining opponent's copy of Revenge.

3630-4772-5007.notablePrerequisites: Morselhorder has at least one -1/-1 counter on it.
3630-4772-5007.description:
Activate Morselhorder by removing all -1/-1 counters from it, adding {B} for each counter removed.
Activate Wandering Mage's third ability by paying {B} and putting two -1/-1 counters on Morselhorder, preventing the next two damage dealt to you this turn.
Repeat.

749-1558-1692-3263.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Lena.
You control at least four nontoken creatures.
749-1558-1692-3263.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lena with haste.
The Lena token enters the battlefield, creating a number of 1/1 Soldier creature tokens equal to the number of nontoken creatures you control.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1340-1409-2060.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Tanazir.
1340-1409-2060.description:
Activate Tanazir by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Tanazir enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Tanazir trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

146-169-5147.description:
Cast Pact of the Titan choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times, paying a total of {0}.
Pact of the Titan's replicate ability triggers, causing you to copy Pact of the Titan for each time the replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Pact of the Titans, creating an arbitrarily large number of 4/4 Giant creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a Giant token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 4.
